__
 
• The passage discusses augmented reality and virtual reality, highlighting how virtual environments are created to simulate real-world experiences.
 
• The word that fits best in this context should describe the visual representation of a famous figure in the virtual environment.
 
• "Rendition" is the correct choice, as it refers to an artistic or visual interpretation or performance, which fits well with the concept of representing Mike Tyson in a virtual boxing ring.
